name: Numbuh 62
source:
Name: Anon Mous

Designation: Numbuh 62

Sector: G

Position: Security Chief/Weapons Expert


Numbuh 62 is always ready to lend a hand to help out his team. He does his best to stay ready for whatever might walk, run, slither, float, or crawl around the corner (unfortunately that's NOT an exaggeration...though he probably wishes it was.)

Despite his team's..."quirks"...Numbuh 62 would do just about anything for any one of them, even though it usually involves an explosion, mutation, or stolen allowance.


"Wait what? Stolen allowance? What stolen allowance?"
